reviewSamples.author: Photo of Ariel acuna
reviewSamples.text: Never seen my truck this cleaned in months. Very professional And on time I highly recommend

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Mariah L
reviewSamples.text: My car looks brand new!! They came over on time and performed a beautiful interior and exterior detail. I’m very happy with the results and will definitely be booking with Marcos Ortiz again!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Daisy Arreguin
reviewSamples.text:
My car hasn't been this sparkling clean since we bought it! Marcos was thorough, and seemed to have reached every nook and cranny.
Prime Detailing and Pressure Washing was professional, reliable and I would highly recommend them, they exceeded my expectations.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Kimberly Hanzlik
reviewSamples.text: Marcus did a beautiful job on my Honda CR-V Touring. When I got in the car it was as new as when I bought it. Marcus is very professional and I will continue to use his services. If you’re looking for a good detail and a fresh look call Prime Detailing and the price is very reasonable.

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Ryan Fredstrom
reviewSamples.text: Amazing job on the car detail. Service was super smooth and professional and showed up the very next day to detail the car. Would 100% recommend to a friend or family . Keep up the great work
